text: {"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["nor will the grief in your heart end (maix tan û Kantal û yatal tauol) -> 'it will not take long to weigh heavily upon your soul'", "he leapt/went away (tu Zitah) -> 'leapt away' is acceptably literal, but the note offers 'withdrew' as an alternative"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["'bul' (gambling/dice) among the elder brother's vices", "'he ca uilic' (when he [the younger brother] saw) is flattened into a plain statement"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["it is no wonder that I resemble him (ma hakotzil ca chacanacentii) -> 'Do not be afraid that I appear to you'", "he almost thought (tacitac û tuculic) -> 'he immediately thought'", "the sweet/good word of God (cici tħan) -> 'holy word of God'", "nor will the grief in your heart end -> 'your heart will not fail to grieve with regret'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A is complete and close to the Maya, while B leaves out the gambling vice and gets Christ's 'it is no wonder that I resemble him' wrong."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["tenderness (in \"with great tenderness and trust\")"], "mistranslated": ["hach Zatal ù pixan (his soul utterly lost) -> \"his soul deeply troubled\"", "caat hob ù ualak tu yol (with these words it entered / turned in his heart) -> \"the heart of this sick man was quieted\"", "ú tħibete hach chacan tiob layob catulob t maniebe (appeared very plainly to them, the two who were there) -> \"whose countenance was very clearly like unto those two who had passed before\""]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["\"hach\" intensifier in \"hach noh pahzubtal\" rendered loosely as \"made complete\""], "added": ["\"who came at once\"", "\"as a shadow\""], "mistranslated": ["kahez ɔocan à manzic u yanalob àzab nohob (remember you have already passed through others, even greater) -> \"after you endure it, other and greater things will come\"", "ɔibolan ti alakoob (desired by your companions) -> \"so coveted by the women\"", "caat hob ù ualak tu yol (it turned / settled in his heart) -> \"When these words entered into the sick man's heart\" (and the clause is merged with the next one)"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Both translations cover the whole page, but B gets the brother's words wrong (\"you have already been through worse\" becomes \"worse things will come\") and adds a few small details, while A's slips are fewer and smaller."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["hach chacan tech (very clear/manifest to you) -> \"very much like you\"", "hebal c tucliceex â hanonexe (what we think about [while eating/awake?], uncertain) -> \"what we think about while we are awake\": the rendering is plausible but uncertain"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["y lay Yumbile in 'hunꝑelili Diozil y lay Yumbile' (one God with the Father): the link to the Father is lost"], "added": ["\"and it stops moving as well\""], "mistranslated": ["bai û peec xan (so too it moves) -> \"and it stops moving as well\"", "u ꝑel mehen Dioz (the only Son of God) -> \"the Person of the Son of God\"", "hunꝑelili Diozil y lay Yumbile (He is one God with the Father) -> \"divinity is one and the same\"", "maix uchac û tabli (nor can He be deceived) -> \"it cannot deceive\"", "topzazil utial tulacal baal (all things are utterly clear to Him) -> \"He is supremely clear to all things\"", "Enrique Gran glossed as Henry of Ghent: this identification is speculative and probably wrong"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A is complete and accurate apart from one small slip, while B has several errors of sense: the moving image, the Son's oneness with the Father, and 'cannot deceive' versus 'cannot be deceived'."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["along with them"], "mistranslated": ["cu yuchul lay ú cha campahal ta Uuyahexloe (this happens / takes firm hold in what you have heard) -> 'This comes to pass through the teaching you have heard' (loose)", "ekmayil ú pictanil uinicoob ... cahlicob (the multitude of men dwell in darkness) -> 'live in darkness' (acceptable), but 'quickly falling into temptation' is fine; the frame 'What is the reason' is slightly freer than 'what is the meaning in your thoughts'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["...that not only the Father and the Son are to be reverenced, and honored, and loved by us, but also (in a meta tag; this text is from the previous page and is not on this page)"], "mistranslated": ["ekmayil (darkness) -> 'blindness'", "tumtabal (temptation/trial) -> 'perdition'", "cu yuchul lay ú cha campahal ta Uuyahexloe -> 'Thus is fulfilled that which takes firm hold in what ye have heard' (awkward and uncertain)"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Both translations are complete and mostly accurate, but A is slightly better: B adds text from the previous page that is not on this page and makes a few lexical slips ('blindness', 'perdition'), although its notes are more thorough."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["ú ualKezic ú yich (turns back His face/countenance) -> \"turning aside the anger\" (interpretive)", "tumen à Uuyiceex he Yumbile tu cħaah... (just because you hear that the Father took the likeness of an old man) -> \"for as you hear, the Father took the likeness...\" (the causal sense that is being denied is blurred)", "yokol ú noh celembal (probably on His right shoulder) -> \"above His magnificent youthful form\" (doubtful)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["y ú yabal Zakcil hebixten (and one in great misery like me) -> \"with such radiant whiteness\" (reads zak 'itch/misery' as zac 'white' and gives it to the visitor)", "caat nucabti tumen Eſpiritu S. (and he was answered by the Holy Spirit) -> \"Then He answered him, through the Holy Spirit\"", "tu pazel (to visit) -> \"to the dwelling of\""]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Both translations cover the whole page, but B misreads 'Zakcil' as 'radiant whiteness' and garbles the passive 'answered by the Holy Spirit', while A has only small interpretive slips."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": ["corrupted the rest"], "mistranslated": ["whether that same habit (náapzahàanil) does not confirm it -> \"whether, if it is constantly delayed, it does not settle\"", "out of habit (napzah) they want to follow the devotions/prayers -> \"because of neglect they turn their backs on prayers of thanksgiving and devotions\"", "because it spoils and becomes disordered (ɔiliƀintic, kexuolaltaƀal) -> \"it becomes loathsome and rejected\"", "shamelessness (mazuƀtalil) grows -> \"shame is born\"", "how much easier the resurrection would have been if, as soon as the soul fell and died, they had called Jesus Christ quickly -> \"how very difficult would a resurrection be ... unless they quickly call upon Jesus Christ\"", "the part that died ruined itself completely -> \"the deadened flesh corrupted the rest\""]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["in their churches"], "mistranslated": ["instruments/means (nuculilóob) -> \"intentions\"", "tu tiƀlilóob (in their good works/devotions) -> \"in their churches\" (doubtful)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B gets the opening clause about habit and the counterfactual Jairus sentence right, while A reverses the sense of both and garbles several other clauses."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["'iix ɔoyanil' (the second of the paired terms of weakness; A renders only 'mere weakness')"], "added": ["'of guilt' in 'fills the measure of guilt'", "'spiritual' in 'spiritual coldness'"], "mistranslated": ["remaining at enmity with God (ti le ú kahualil Dios) -> 'remain distant from the presence of God'", "these slights multiplied by the number of graces (tioklal le ú xocolilóob) -> 'weighed against the number of divine graces'", "an insult that makes all the rest appear (cú cħiczic ù chucáanil) -> 'an injury that fills the measure of guilt'", "to fall and rise quickly is much shorter than falling and staying -> 'is a brief stumble, rather than falling'", "the evil you do to yourselves by that lack of spirit and laziness -> 'the evil you inflict upon yourselves, and that spiritual coldness and sloth' (the cause is turned into a second object)", "'c paymaéex' (we are obliged / we must) -> 'we urge you'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["freedom in that same will (halkaƀil ti leyli uolah) -> 'a surrender of that same will'", "remaining at enmity with God (ti le ú kahualil Dios) -> 'mired against the majesty of God'", "if you (plural) want to ask (ua uolticéexi káatic) -> 'if we are willing to ask for it'", "'emá chichpolal' (and not contempt) -> 'and not an instrument of contempt'"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B follows the Maya clause structure more closely and has only small slips of sense, while A paraphrases loosely, adds phrases such as 'of guilt' and 'spiritual', and garbles the final rhetorical question."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": ["'nucul' (manner) in 'cá Dios cú pocħol yáaƀ ti le nucul' is dropped: the 'how much God is insulted' clause loses 'in the manner'"], "added": ["\"or to speak more fully\""], "mistranslated": ["'leyti zipil ... lay hach kaz' (this sin is very evil/foul) -> 'so foul' (acceptable)", "'chucáanil cà ú tħanóob' (how perfect are his words) -> 'or to speak more fully, his words'", "'má yohel heƀic unchac ú nachcunzic' (it is not known how far it can reach) -> 'our understanding does not know how it could disregard them'", "'ú chunil nucul ti ú ɔiliƀ' (the foundation of instruction / example in his writing) -> 'the principal model for his imitation'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": ["\"whom we do not first recognize\"", "\"in doctrine\" (second occurrence, 'deeply offended in doctrine')"], "mistranslated": ["'leti uol hach heɔáan' (even the most steadfast heart) -> 'the soul, thoroughly terrified'", "'cà má c paymaéex kaholticéex' (that we ought to recognize) -> 'whom we do not first recognize'", "'hele ú nuculintic ù mentic à uilaéex' (now I intend to make you see) -> 'Today he intends to show you'", "'cá Dios cú pocħol yáaƀ ti le nucul y cá' (how much God is insulted by the manner in which) -> 'how God is deeply offended in doctrine and how'", "'ú núuctenóob' (understand me) -> 'answer me'", "'judióob ti tulacal ù nummia hach yaé' (the Jews throughout his bitter passion) -> 'the Jews in all their grievous afflictions'", "'ah pak keƀan cħuplal' (adulterous woman) -> 'sinful woman'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A is complete and accurate except for a few slips in the opening sentence of Part I, while B misreads several key clauses, including who suffers, the speaker's intent and the listeners' response."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["'ti hahual' (of destruction/desolation) in the Maya rendering of the verse"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["toil ti le yayatulul keƀan (to the weeping/contrition for sin) -> 'for grievous sins promptly'", "tu zeƀlacil cá uohléex tu hahil (as soon as you truly know) -> 'so that we truly understand'", "utial á zàat-zahul ti h keƀanéex (for your forgiving of sinners) -> 'for the forgiveness of our sins'", "mazuƀtalil hach pectaƀil ti hahual (most abominable shamefulness of desolation) -> 'that shameful and utterly detestable thing'", "káaxóob (forests/wild country) -> 'mountains'", "cú tħan leti Yumil táan ú zeƀchitic humpel nohoch okom uol (the Lord speaks foretelling a great sorrow) -> 'The words of the Lord swiftly awaken a great sorrow'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["'and that fervent trust'", "meta: '...call quickly upon the Lord through his Sacrament of' (supposed text from the previous page, which is not on this page)"], "mistranslated": ["tac ú caxtcechóob (until they seek you) -> 'until they find you'"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B follows the Maya more closely: it renders the Maya forms of 'forests', 'desolation', 'forgiveness of sinners' and the prophecy wording correctly, with only a small added phrase. A has several slips of sense and misreads the final sentence."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["ú nacuntic (probably 'injures/wounds') -> 'who loathes' (uncertain)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": [], "added": ["how should they act?"], "mistranslated": ["báax cú uetħic chucanil éma leti má cimzah ('what else does it forbid besides killing') -> 'what does it completely forbid, namely, not to kill?'", "Hebic y le ú mehentzilóob Diosé ('as with the children of God') -> 'Just as God acts toward His children'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A follows the catechism's sense closely, while B misreads the fifth-commandment question, recasts the masters' answer as being about God's behaviour, and adds a phrase."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["'hun hatzul … ú láak' (on one side … on the other): the contrast between the two sides is flattened into 'In like manner … likewise'"], "added": ["so that it may serve to correct what you already recognize"], "mistranslated": ["Ahzáat-zahuléex 'your Redeemer/Forgiver' -> 'our Ahzáat-zah'", "Ahzáat-zah zipiléex 'Forgiver of your sins' -> 'our Forgiver of sins'", "cú yiláal cá … 'it is seen that (he held) irreverence a grievous sin' -> 'showing that our Savior acted thus because irreverence … is a most grievous sin'", "Mesa (singular table) -> 'the tables'", "ti máax cú talel ú ɔá zipil 'to whom occasion of sin is given' -> 'whereby occasions of sin arise'", "napzah uaiix tá kaholticéex 'that you may remember or recognize it' -> 'correct what you already recognize'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["devout (people)"], "mistranslated": ["c nuculil cuxtaléex (first-person plural 'c' mixed with second-person plural '-éex') -> 'your lives' (a defensible reading, but the 'our' is dropped)", "napzah uaiix tá kaholticéex 'that you may remember or recognize it' -> 'accustom yourselves to it or recognize it'", "má unchac ù macunzaƀal 'cannot be hidden/covered' -> 'cannot be tolerated'"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B keeps the second-person forms of the source, the contrast between the two sides, and the meaning of the closing list of sins better than A, which has several small shifts in meaning and adds a 'correct' clause."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["c meyahtbaóob (our work/occupations) -> 'our pious devotions'", "le xmá tiblil (lack of decency, probably idleness as in the Spanish catechism) -> 'bad conduct' (loose)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["especially"], "mistranslated": ["pacatóob iix tzicbalóob nuculanóob kaz (glances and conversations inclined to evil) -> 'dishonorable gazes, and evil conversations' (the shared modifier is split; small slip)"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "Both translations are complete and close to the source, but A turns 'c meyahtbaóob' (our work) into 'pious devotions', while B's slips are smaller: one added word ('especially') and a modifier split between two nouns."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["'nucul' (notable/serious) qualifying the harm in the first answer"], "added": ["\"or loss\"", "\"evil\" (in 'The evil desires of the flesh')"], "mistranslated": ["u comiló, its owner -> 'his neighbor'", "cú ɔanuculinte hebic unchacé, bahun tu lá hié, he should keep the intention to do it when he can, as far as he is able -> 'He makes provision as he is able, and for the rest when he has it'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": ["'má utzi' (wrongful/unjust) qualifying the harm in the first answer"], "added": ["\"worldly\" (in 'worldly riches')"], "mistranslated": ["mix cú yubicóob x má xulilóob, nor listens to them without need -> 'nor listens to endless vain words'", "'má' in uamá, unless/if not, is rendered loosely as 'if he does not pay'; the sense is kept"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B correctly has the debt paid back to the owner and keeps the intention to make restitution, while A gives these as 'neighbor' and a confused 'provision' answer; B's main slip is reading 'x má xulilóob' as 'endless vain words' instead of 'without need'."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["since the Mass has been mentioned (Bahun ti ú yabal misa) -> 'Regarding the hearing of Mass'", "those by whom they are said (tumen máax cú yalabalóob, i.e. the priests who say them) -> 'Those on whose behalf they are said'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["complete/entire reverence (tulul tzic) -> 'supreme reverence'", "those by whom they are said (tumen máax cú yalabalóob) -> 'those for whom they are said'"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "Both translations are complete and close to the Ripalda original, but B correctly gives 'Since Mass is spoken of' where A has 'Regarding the hearing of Mass', so B has fewer slips of sense."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["'pelelil' (special/particular) in the third question: the commandment is not said to be a special one"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["desire to have much wealth or anything else by good means (tu beil tibilil) -> 'other than for a good purpose' (reverses the condition)", "only illicit and excessive desires (taɔmanzahóob) are forbidden -> 'coveted unlawfully and through dishonest means'", "forbidden by a special commandment -> 'forbidden by these commandments'", "because their thoughts and motions are very evil -> 'from them arise evil thoughts and evil inclinations'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 5, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": []}, "better": "B", "comment": "B renders every question and answer faithfully, in line with Ripalda's catechism, while A reverses the condition in the first question, drops 'special commandment' and misreads the answer about thoughts and motions."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["when one receives it"], "mistranslated": ["ra hilaxic paru vi (its being read/pronounced over one) -> \"its absolution is requested over one\"", "ru ꜯiriçaxic (its absolution/release) -> \"one's blessing\"", "ru ꜫitahic hun vinak (uncertain: visiting/ministering to a person) -> \"in the hour of a person's death\" (an interpretive reading)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 3, "omitted": ["ni ma cochih (the great gift/benefit) that the person receives through the Bull is left out and reduced to 'receives absolution'"], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["pa ꜭhavomariçabal hay (house of purification, a gloss for Purgatory) -> \"or in the hospital\"", "ru ꜯiriçaxic (its absolution) -> \"its being applied\"", "ruçachic (forgiveness) is kept, but 'chini marayil' (in great suffering) is weakened to plain 'suffering'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Both follow the source closely, but B turns the Kaqchikel gloss for Purgatory into 'hospital' and drops the 'great gift' phrase, while A's slips are smaller interpretive ones."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["and office"], "mistranslated": ["ꜭhirughumumibal 'with groaning/sighing' -> 'in the sorrow'", "ru ꜫekuma ꜫaꜫal 'darkness, fire' -> 'the dark fire' (two terms merged into one)"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["ruꜫatatibal ga ka gux 'burning/heat of our hearts' -> 'contrition (breaking) of our hearts'", "paru ꜭhij 'at its mouth/edge' -> 'from the burning heat'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "Both translations cover the whole page and get the main sense right, but A keeps the 'burning of our hearts' image and the 'mouth' of the burning place, while B wrongly makes it 'contrition/breaking' and 'burning heat'; A in turn softens 'groaning' to 'sorrow' and adds 'office'."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["the instrument of"], "mistranslated": ["ꜭhuça ꜭhic ('and also, further') -> 'the forgiving and the wiping away' (the accompanying note wrongly calls it a couplet about erasing)", "tan ti giꜯ ruçaꜭh Padre Saçerdote ('while the Father Priest is giving absolution') -> 'When the pronouncement of the Father Priest ... is concluded'", "ꜭhi ꜫihalonic (an observance, possibly vigil or prayer) -> 'prayer and visitation'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": [], "added": ["he shall take patience", "it is greatly to be honored, its presence"], "mistranslated": ["tu coꜭhih yi ru nima hoyeuaxic, ru vaꜭh ('he receives the great mercy upon himself') -> 'he shall take patience, and it is greatly to be honored, its presence'", "ru ꜭhohmil ('its proper manner/order') -> 'its proper benefit'", "vue ta ki ꜯih ... ah ghumum, ah ꜫatat gux ('if truly we are contrite, with burning hearts') -> 'Even if truly we are proud, hard-hearted'", "oh ta ga ah biꜯ, ah ahil ꜭhiroꜫexic ronohel kamac ('we are weepers, counters of all our sins') -> 'songsters, merrymakers, weeping over all our sins'", "ꜭhibiꜯ ('with weeping') -> 'with hymns'"]}, "better": "A", "comment": "A follows the sense of the confession instructions closely with only minor slips, while B misreads the contrition couplets as their opposites (proud, hard-hearted, merrymakers) and garbles the opening clause."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 2, "omitted": ["'vue ka ru la huna' – 'even ten years' we might stay there", "'ka ꜯol ꜫomibal kij' – our means of healing/restoring ourselves", "the sense of sins already being 'washed' ('ꜭhica nihraꜭh ça ꜭhic rumac'), which is replaced by 'lightened'"], "added": ["wasting their days instead of making satisfaction for their sins", "is immediately lightened"], "mistranslated": ["ꜭhavomariçabal hay, house of washing/purification -> 'house of torment'", "'ma ni xkilih' (we did not heed it) -> 'they did not finish it'", "first-person plural 'we/our' -> third person 'someone/they'", "'when a person's sins are already washed, the remaining debt...' -> 'the punishment for a person's sins is immediately lightened'", "'haga tan ti gamon vi lo-' (that is where one receives, continuing onto the next page) -> 'it is now received from this'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": ["'that is where one receives the indulgence': the source only says 'there one receives...' and continues onto the next page"], "mistranslated": ["'vaue ni gahçak' -> 'here in the light of the world': the reading is uncertain and the note's claim about a traditional pairing is speculative", "the note 'through sacramental confession' is interpretive and not in the source"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "B follows the source closely clause by clause (ten years, healing remedy, washed sins), while A mistranslates the purification house as 'torment', drops several phrases and adds 'wasting their days'."}

{"A": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["(lo)ꜫobal 'love/grace, mercy' (the first part of a word split from the previous page) -> 'a ransom' (with a note glossing it as 'recompense')", "ꜭhi kih 'for us / on our behalf' -> 'for them'", "ꜭhivi 'to you (plural)' -> 'to them'"]}, "B": {"fidelity": 4, "omitted": [], "added": [], "mistranslated": ["ꜭhivi ꜭhiki 'to you all' (last line) -> 'to them'"]}, "better": "B", "comment": "Both translations cover the whole page, but B reads 'loꜫobal' correctly as love/mercy and renders 'ꜭhi kih' correctly as 'on our behalf', where A has 'a ransom' and 'for them'."}
